candidates.researchQuestion: Where does authority move when an assistant hands a reservation action to an external provider?
candidates.title: A Reservation Button Does Not Own the Reservation
candidates.title_zh: 预订按钮并不拥有预订结果

sections.heading: What changed in the reservation flow
Questions left at the provider boundary
sections.heading_zh: 提供方边界仍有哪些问题

evidenceClaims.claim: Official product documentation reports that the user can review reservation details before provider placement.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 官方产品文档报告称，用户可以在提交给提供方之前检查预订信息。

evidenceClaims.claim: The documented boundary suggests that availability, submission, confirmation and later custody should remain separate states.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 文档所示边界表明，可用、提交、确认与后续托管应保持为不同状态。

projectRelevance.rationale: The provider-authority question is complete as external industry research.

communityEdition.rationale: Connector developers can discuss one narrower API-boundary question.
communityEdition.title: Where Should an Agent Stop During a Reservation Handoff?
communityEdition.title_zh: 预订交接时，Agent 应该在哪里停下？
communityEdition.angle: Which lifecycle states and receipts a connector API should expose.
communityEdition.discussionQuestion: Should provider confirmation and post-booking custody be separate typed outcomes?

candidates.researchQuestion: What does a stable event identity guarantee across asynchronous retries, and what does it leave unproven?
candidates.title: Stable Event Identity Is a Reconciliation Primitive, Not Exactly-Once Delivery
candidates.title_zh: 稳定事件身份是对账原语，不是恰好一次投递

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged implementation assigns an event identifier before asynchronous handoff and reuses it for retries.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 合并后的实现会在异步交接前分配事件标识，并在重试时复用该标识。

evidenceClaims.claim: The mechanism supports retry reconciliation but does not establish end-to-end exactly-once business execution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该机制支持重试对账，但并未证明端到端业务执行具备恰好一次语义。

projectRelevance.rationale: The mechanism and its guarantee boundary are useful without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete technical analysis already serves the relevant engineering audience.

candidates.researchQuestion: Which fact should grant an agent permission to execute queued work?
candidates.title: Queued Work Is Demand; a Worker Claim Grants Execution Authority
candidates.title_zh: 排队任务表示需求，Worker Claim 才授予执行权

sections.heading: Queue and claim are different facts
sections.heading_zh: 排队与认领是不同事实

sections.heading: What operators must be able to see
sections.heading_zh: 运维人员必须看见什么

sections.heading: Failure cases worth testing next
sections.heading_zh: 下一步应测试的失败场景

evidenceClaims.claim: A maintainer changelog reports ordered queuing within a local session and separate support for concurrent sessions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 维护者变更记录报告了本地会话内的顺序排队，以及多个会话并发运行的独立能力。

evidenceClaims.claim: An internal Research Center runtime record observed that a scheduler wake and a worker claim can be recorded as separate operational facts; this is internal evidence, not independent validation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Research Center 的一份内部运行记录观察到，调度唤醒与 Worker Claim 可以被记录为不同的运行事实；这是内部证据，不是独立验证。

projectRelevance.rationale: The engineering rule is stated for queued agent runtimes generally, without first-party project promotion.

communityEdition.rationale: A community angle should wait for crash-recovery test evidence.
